note: Submodule of memory_limit_policy providing the 'route' MemoryLimitConstraint plugin (class Route). Cases are grounded in the real plugin id, its config keys, and its evaluate() logic. Medium/hard scripts use mlp_route_* policies built with the real 'route' constraint config and verified by loading the memory_limit_policy config entity.

evals.prompt: Which constraint plugin ids does memory_limit_policy_route provide, and what does each match?
evals.expected_output: Two: 'route' (class Route) matches when the current route name is in the configured 'routes' list, and 'admin_route' (class AdminRoute) matches any admin route via router.admin_context->isAdminRoute().

evals.prompt: When I enter route names in a memory_limit_policy route constraint, what happens if a route name doesn't exist?
evals.expected_output: The form validates each route via route_provider->getRouteByName() and sets a form error 'The route @route does not exist.' for unknown names, so invalid routes cannot be saved.

evals.prompt: How do I apply a memory limit to every admin page without listing routes individually?
evals.expected_output: Use the 'admin_route' constraint plugin; it returns TRUE for any admin route (router.admin_context->isAdminRoute()) and needs no route list.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has an enabled memory limit policy 'mlp_route_known' whose only constraint is the 'route' condition from the memory_limit_policy_route submodule. Inspect the live configuration and report the value(s) configured for that constraint.
evals.expected_output: The policy mlp_route_known (config memory_limit_policy.memory_limit_policy.mlp_route_known) has a single 'route' constraint configured with system.admin. Read it from the entity's policy_constraints.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create an enabled memory limit policy with machine id 'mlp_route_exec' (memory 768M) whose single constraint uses the 'route' condition from the memory_limit_policy_route submodule: a Route constraint whose routes include 'user.login'. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create the memory_limit_policy config entity mlp_route_exec with memory '768M', status TRUE, and a policy_constraints entry {id: route, negate: false, ...} matching 'a Route constraint whose routes include 'user.login'' (e.g. via the entity storage or the add-policy form).
